# Original saved plan current product authority

This source packet adds final product target and human approval admission to the existing paired saved-plan runtime. It is not a production acceptance result. The author executed no compiler, lint, test, package, PostgreSQL, OpenTofu, Temporal, browser, API or cloud command. The full 78 production requirements remain unchanged.

The prepared tree is `83e9e84333a055e9be4f3157bbd365ae0d4bd081` over `d5b68107319aa509e86352aab2fb6bd15e47abe6`. Its 23 read-only dependency paths contain the independently reviewed MCP R1/R2/R3 and corrected R4 fixture plus the private PostgreSQL opening and default hosted client provenance. The exact preparation, dependency hashes and private index are retained outside the repository under `logs/plan-product-dispatch-authority-20261004/revision1`. Earlier packet source and receipts are immutable.

The author owns exactly eleven paths: the native plan repository, its new product authority helper, the paired platform runtime, the native product test, the existing saved-binary handoff test, this document, the platform worker broker, the closed execution types, the current requirement test, the default broker composition and its origin test. Canonical CI registration is outside this packet.

The native repository derives current authority from the sealed original artifact, the original immutable approved revision and saved manifest, the owning workspace/project/environment/deployment chain, the public to native provider mapping, full native provider configuration and current verified status. It reconstructs the canonical V1 upgrade and desired graph. Deploy retains exact immutable Git snapshots and service/pipeline recipes. Destroy mirrors `execution/destroy.context`: the deployed desired nodes plus live retained historical native nodes, sorted by JavaScript lexical address order, with the established destroy graph digest. Source-free deletion of a deployed Git service does not acquire build source. Every retained historical tuple and its live membership is repeated in the final SQL statement.

An observation witness records only bounded identifiers, original immutable artifact hashes, a semantic digest and original reconstruction IDs. It contains no raw provider configuration, credentials, saved manifest, policy input or approval details. Product origin is retained at publication, so deletion of all public rows cannot turn a known product artifact into historical native absence. Claim records an attempt-bound witness. Original format1 artifact bytes and hashes are preserved, including associated destroy artifacts whose source operation differs from the destination operation.

The claim and dispatch transactions take the existing operation/resource locks and an explicit owning use-row lock, then issue a separate READ COMMITTED statement. The final statement repeats current product ownership, saved manifest, target/region/configuration, native provider, requester membership, current source/recipe/binding predicates and exact original artifact/witness. Committed changes while the use row was blocked are visible to that fresh statement. Remote role reads occur before this transaction. The private current policy lookup loads the captured broker's current policy version without a separate pool query inside the occupied transaction. No lock spans an external current-role RPC.

The canonical worker broker privately captures its actual evaluated approval requirement before approving-human role awaits. It verifies that the evaluated input digest, native operation, first retained plan facts, resolved native workspace policy and effective environment autonomy are consistent. The deeply detached and frozen capture includes exact native approval candidates, current settings and original plan evidence. Only the genuine returned dispatch snapshot has a private registry entry. The internal platform boundary preserves that object identity; the repository separately freezes SQL parameter values. Copies, foreign owning SQL objects or operation scopes, inconsistent evaluation input and changed policy version cannot supply this authority. The registry is same-attempt provenance, not a durable recovery record or another execution queue.

Final product dispatch repeats native operation/proposal/input/plan/round, native settings presence and tuples, original plan evidence, all captured consumed approval rows, human identity, current workspace scope/minRole, distinct required count, separation of duties, expiry and rejection. A default environment settings capture requires absence of the globally keyed environment row, including foreign occupants. Approval holder demotion/removal/foreign scope during its awaited role lookup therefore refuses the original provider call even if a modeled role reply remains stale.

Default production dispatch additionally requires an actual default-created broker/store/dependency composition and genuine same-target opened PostgreSQL handles. Registration exists only inside the factories. Fixed boolean lookups validate original methods/descriptors, default ports, configured explicit target and genuine opening provenance without evaluating replacement getters. Test overrides, caller-registered stores or roles/scopes, copied brokers, substituted methods/accessors, closed/tampered handles and startup target override options refuse default mutation origin. The existing hosted composition checks remain mandatory: private default REST client, configured owning co-resident Supabase PostgreSQL database, supported schema and role, explicit immutable opening target. A separate product store cannot supply an atomic final SQL predicate and refuses transparently.

Deploy excludes benign current working copies, display/progress metadata, active deployment pointers and later deployed revision pointers from unchanged original effects. Destroy additionally repeats the current promoted `environments.deployed_revision_id`, including null, against the original witness because that pointer chooses the deletion target. Benign human metadata changes do not invalidate unchanged membership/roles. Missing/malformed/foreign witness, target/source/configuration/ownership change and human authority change refuse. Claimed/dispatched/uncertain phases and lost commit response non-replay behavior are retained. An accepted provider call cannot be retracted by a later revocation.

There are explicit remaining implementation gaps. New product-backed integration or Navigator dispatch refuses because credential and browser-journal grant scope/revocation is a separate authority; an `onBehalfOf` member or copied scopes cannot establish a final native grant CAS. Product-backed resource-scoped dispatch also refuses where the canonical policy resource facts come from a newer working/deployed projection instead of the exact original approved target. Environment-level human deploy/destroy is the supported new path. Default production also refuses ambiguous historical native absence without immutable product origin; only the existing `NODE_ENV=test` recognized isolated runtime keeps source-free native fixture compatibility. These are release blockers requiring bounded native grant/resource derivation and a source-bound legacy migration/review, not requirement closure.

An existing earlier `execution/apply.ts` pre-dispatch custody reread can still refuse a benign pointer advance before the paired role window. That availability behavior is outside ownership. The separate public MCP recovery-before-attempted-readback limitation is unchanged. No atomicity is claimed across the separate credential/journal stores or between final native admission and accepted provider I/O.

The new native suite uses three actual independent PostgreSQL pools, canonical public collection DDL, native broker records, immutable original custody and observed `pg_blocking_pids` waits. Current-role answers, hosted REST association, policy decisions and provider counters are explicitly modeled. Its synthetic sealed payload is not real OpenTofu or live provider evidence. Cases cover held requester/approver waits, changed target/config/ownership/member/settings/facts, source service/pipeline JSON with unchanged digests, witness corruption, genuine source-free Git destroy with retained historical rows, deployed destroy pointer mutation, benign deploy pointer movement, claim/use-row waits and lost/uncertain native commit outcomes.

The additive saved-binary controls use an independent producer process and the real pinned OpenTofu builtin resource against local state. They verify original raw bytes, poison an unused replacement plan, fence held-role region and approver/destination changes, and require exact once-only apply/destroy effects. Hosted REST association, policy/directory and browser identity remain explicit models. All original saved-binary case bodies remain byte-identical. The focused requirement suite uses real native records with modeled policy/current directory; the default origin suite checks actual default factories and genuine PostgreSQL opening without asserting REST, role, policy or cloud acceptance. No modeled result establishes effective provider permissions.
